Now I'll write an improved, more understandable version. Let me check my working directory.Now let me compile-check.The improved `ArrayFillTest.java` compiles successfully (`COMPILE_OK`). I refactored it for understandability — grouped the tests into `clear`, `fill(value)`, and `fill(generator)` sections with explanatory header comments, renamed cryptic variables (`val`→`fillValue`, `actual`→`result`), added intent-revealing comments (e.g. NUL `'\0'` vs digit `'0'`, inclusive/exclusive range semantics, the index-to-value generator contract), collapsed the range tests to a single clear `assertArrayEquals` of the expected array, and tightened the null-passthrough tests — all while keeping the exact same CUT method calls, arguments, and expected outcomes.
